title: Eventual lifting of morphisms from fixed finite affine free families
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ an inverse system of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, and $(X,\pi)$ a limit cone [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative ring, fix $i\in I$, an etale module sheaf $G$ on $D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and a finite family of affine etale objects $W_1,\ldots,W_m$ of $D_i$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Put $A=\bigoplus_k j_{W_k!}\underline\Lambda_{W_k}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension], [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For every $f:\pi_i^{-1}A\to\pi_i^{-1}G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] there exist $j\ge i$ and $a:t_{ji}^{-1}A\to t_{ji}^{-1}G$, where $t_{ji}:D_j\to D_i$ is the transition, such that $\pi_j^{-1}(a)\circ C_G^{-1}=C_A^{-1}\circ f$. Here $C:\pi_i^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}\pi_j^{-1}t_{ji}^{-1}$ is the canonical inverse-image composition isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]. The family may be empty. No constructibility or finiteness condition on $G$ or $\Lambda$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09YU (3), fully faithful argument on finitely many free generators, and Tag 09YQ in degree zero; Tag 03S6. Verified at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YU and /tag/09YQ.

proof.text: Import shriekEvalEquiv and shriekEvalEquiv_comp from AffineFreeEtaleModuleFamilyModels, where the section equivalence and its postcomposition naturality are proved once using the shriek/pullback, constant-sheaf and rank-one-module adjunctions. Reuse this equivalence on each summand; do not reconstruct it in this module.

Transpose each inverse-image coprojection followed by f along the projection adjunction and use shriekEvalEquiv to obtain a generating section z_k of lowerStar upperStar G at W_k. Apply the surjectivity clause of limit_pullback_sections_colimit to z_k. Bound the finite set of resulting stages, together with i, using Finset.exists_le. Apply the theorem's transition section maps tau to move each section to this upper bound; its cocone identity proves that rho maps the resulting section to z_k.

Use the inverse of shriekEvalEquiv to turn these sections into arrows b_k from the original summands to the direct image of the stage-j pullback of G. Form Sigma.desc b and transpose it through the transition adjunction to obtain a.

Prove the private transpose_comp_pullback identity for arbitrary A and G: expand homEquiv using the unit, apply upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app, and commute the morphism using naturality of lowerStarComp and of the upperStar unit. The expression on the right is precisely the section map rho. Precompose the requested square by C_A.hom and transpose through the projection adjunction. Use Sigma.hom_ext; each summand reduces by shriekEvalEquiv naturality and homEquiv_naturality_left to the rho-section equation of step 2. Cancel C_A.hom to finish.

theorem exists_affine_free_etaleModule_eventual_hom_lift
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    (i : I) (m : ℕ) (W : Fin m → (D.obj (op i)).Etale)
    (hW : ∀ k, IsAffine (W k).left)
    (G : Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    let Q : (D.obj (op i)).Etale →
        Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) :=
      fun Z ↦ (Etale.etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) Z.hom inferInstance).obj
        ((constantSheaf Z.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
          (ModuleCat.of Λ Λ))
    let A := ∐ fun k : Fin m ↦ Q (W k)
    ∀ f : (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (c.π.app (op i))).obj A ⟶
        (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (c.π.app (op i))).obj G,
      ∃ (j : I) (h : i ≤ j)
        (a : (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (D.map (homOfLE h).op)).obj A ⟶
          (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (D.map (homOfLE h).op)).obj G),
        (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (c.π.app (op j))).map a ≫
          (Etale.upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (c.π.app (op j))
            (D.map (homOfLE h).op) (c.π.app (op i))
            (c.w (homOfLE h).op).symm).inv.app G =
        (Etale.upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (c.π.app (op j))
          (D.map (homOfLE h).op) (c.π.app (op i))
          (c.w (homOfLE h).op).symm).inv.app A ≫ f
